title: Sound Certificate Search for NATE Contrast Recovery in LM-Graph Structural Causal Models
banked_reason: D0.5.G: incremental ceiling 3.8 below field threshold 7.4; the load-bearing nonreachability-to-common-law strictly-positive twin theorem and constructive decoder remain absent after bounded attempts.
gap_reasons: The stated research question is completeness of RC-LM-CERT+, but the note proves only soundness and completeness relative to its own declared proof grammar; the load-bearing implication from saturation failure to an indistinguishable positive twin remains open.
Four successful fixtures and one explicit twin do not establish lossless normalization or a general failure certificate, and Figure 3(b), a required regression, is explicitly not covered.
The topic promises FAILURE output as positive rational paired lm-SCMs on saturation failure, whereas this node leaves both the general twin construction and its compilation/decoder open.
proof_attempt_summary: The run built and reviewed a finite proof-relevant RC-LM-CERT+ hypergraph, repaired its observation, positivity, target-cancellation, and transport semantics, and proved several regression and restricted-coverage results. Three D0 solve rounds, three directives, and two maximality passes did not produce the field-level converse from target nonreachability to a common-law positive lm-SCM twin pair or its constructive decoder; a local selected-root bug also remains, but fixing it would not lift the incremental result to the field floor.
tldr: RC-LM-CERT+ is a finite, terminating, sound certificate search, not a proved complete decision procedure for arbitrary-score NATE recovery. A reachable contrast Target reconstructs one evaluable expression with noncircular positivity ancestry on every realizable proxy fiber. On the precise proxy-free intersection with observed parentless label controls and the full positive observational law, contextwise ordinary-ID derivations compile one way into the calculus; no converse or global transfer is claimed. Four positive recovery regressions are theorem-backed: the Napkin value \(1/(4t)-2/7\), its genuine-shift embedding, confounding-free context averaging, and the transported value \(17/60\). The positive \(1/6\)-versus-\(1/3\) twin is theorem-backed separately. For de Aguas Figure 3(b), the second maximality pass identifies the exact pre-FIX denominator as \(P(A\mid Z,W,R_W)\). Its unspecialized Rec and Pos keys cannot be generated from legal cells because \(W\) is erased at \(R_W=0\); projecting \(W\) instead induces \(A\leftrightarrow Y\), making \(A\) nonfixable, while the directly recovered observed conditional is not a fixed structural district endpoint. The published identity therefore remains a retained but unverified calculus test. Full semantic completeness remains equivalent to the open nonreachability-to-twin implication.
gap: General lm-SCM NATE recovery is unresolved, and a responsible decision theorem must distinguish structural recoverability from evaluation at an impossible supplied proxy table.
fill: Prove all twenty tags sound as uniform templates on every realizable fiber of every admissible input, validate all exact fixtures with explicit witness laws, and decide whether every unreachable admissible instance yields a same-law positive paired model.
